Title: Public Preview: Well-Architected Framework assessment on Azure Advisor

Body.Content: The Well-Architected Framework (WAF) assessment provides a holistic view of a workload’s architecture. Take the WAF assessment and manage recommendations on Azure Advisor to improve resiliency, security, cost, operational excellence and performance efficiency. As a part of this release, we are announcing two key WAF assessments. Visit Mission Critical | Well-Architected Review (microsoft.com) and Azure Well-Architected Review (microsoft.com) to learn more.
